d:
Some feelings can't be drowned, no matter how hard you try Watch Sharaab, sung by Diljit Dosanjh, with lyrics by Satta Kotli Wala, now brought to life in a stunning new visual.
Diljit's soulful voice carries every bit of the ache of a heart that's trying to forget, but can't. A song for the quiet, late-night moments when memories hit the hardest
Song Credits
Song - Sharaab
Singer - Diljit Dosanjh
Lyrics - Satta Kotli Wala
Label - Speed Records
